remarks: Welcome to 1633 Washington Blvd, Unit 3D, a beautifully appointed 2-bedroom, 2-bath condo offering comfort, convenience, and a prime Stamford location. This bright home features an open floor plan with hardwood floors throughout and a spacious living area that opens to a private balcony overlooking Scalzi Park, also accessible from the primary suite for seamless indoor-outdoor living. The kitchen is designed to impress with granite countertops and stainless steel appliances, perfect for everyday meals or entertaining. The primary suite includes a walk-in closet and an en-suite bath, while geothermal HVAC, central air conditioning, and in-unit laundry provide efficient, year-round ease. Located directly across from Scalzi Park and near a public golf course, this condo is just moments from shops, dining, and downtown Stamford amenities. The elevator building offers added conveniences, including a gym and sauna. Two parking spaces, one garage and one carport, are included, and the pet-friendly community adds to the appeal. Enjoy refined living in the heart of Stamford.
